endpoint_boarding_points.to: Port de Sidi Youssef, Kerkennah (Iles Kerkennah)

_demand_record.detail: Boat is the ONLY mode -> the addressable pool IS the ferry throughput, near-full, NO haircut (the Phuket->Phi Phi analogue). Sonotrak reportedly carries almost 3.5 million passengers/year on the Sfax<->Sidi Youssef route. Throughput counts both embark+disembark movements -> est_demand_oneway_yr = 3,500,000 / 2 = ~1,750,000. full_pool_preharvest = 3,500,000. Service is dense: ~8-10 sailings/day each way in low season, near-hourly until midnight in summer; permanent island population 15,501 (2014 census) plus heavy summer/diaspora tourism and daily commuters. endpoint_boarding_points.to: La Marsa Plage corniche quay / Gammarth beach jetty (greenfield boarding point)

_demand_record.detail: Affluent north-coast corridor on the TGM's northern reach (Marsa Plage is the line's northern terminus). Base = TGM 7.4M pax/yr; apply a LOW 3% premium-willing haircut (La Marsa is the far end of the line, lower O-D flow, but the highest-income catchment in Tunisia -> premium propensity offsets) = ~222,000 one-way/yr. full_pool_preharvest = 7,400,000 (whole TGM line). WARNING: SHARED 7.4M pool with the two other TGM-parallel corridors -- do NOT sum additively.

endpoint_boarding_points.from: Tunis Marine quay (Lake of Tunis western edge), Tunis

_demand_record.detail: PRIMARY Lake-of-Tunis modal-shift corridor. Base = TGM line ridership ~7.4M pax/yr (Railway Gazette). The Tunis Marine<->La Goulette lake crossing is the TGM's core commuter flow (city centre to the eastern suburbs/port). Apply a 4% premium-willing fast-shuttle haircut = ~296,000 one-way/yr. full_pool_preharvest = 7,400,000 (whole TGM line). WARNING: SHARED 7.4M pool with the other two TGM-parallel corridors -- do NOT sum additively. This is the corridor to which the full TGM pool is most naturally attributed (core flow).

endpoint_boarding_points.from: Agadir Marina (Marina d'Agadir)

_demand_record.detail: Tourist-inflow anchor. Agadir Al Massira airport handled ~3.1M passengers in 2024 (saturated vs 2.5M capacity; +36% in first 11 months). Arrivals ~= 1,550,000 (half of total pax). Apply a 5% premium beach/resort-shuttle propensity (mid-band: high-value leisure inflow to the Agadir-Taghazout bay, congested coastal road) = ~77,500 one-way/yr. full_pool_preharvest = 3,100,000 (total airport pax; arrivals ~1.55M). Context: Souss-Massa region logged 8.8M overnight stays in 2025 (~20% of Morocco's national total).

_demand_record.detail: RE-ANCHOR of the existing registry stub (was demand null). Boat is the ONLY/dominant mode for this crossing -> the addressable pool IS the ferry throughput, near-full, no haircut. Port of Tarifa handled 1,521,555 passengers in 2025 (+14% YoY; ~1.33M in 2024), essentially all on the Tarifa<->Tangier Ville fast-ferry route. Port stats count both embark+disembark movements -> est_demand_oneway_yr = 1,521,555 / 2 = ~760,778. full_pool_preharvest = 1,521,555 (2025 total movements). One of the busiest passenger crossings between Europe and Africa.
